desc.en: A metal processed from magical ore. It's resistant against heat and water, and while it's known for its distinct strength, due to its weight this material is highly divisive in opinion.
desc.ja: 魔力を秘めた鉱石を加工した金属。熱や水に強く、強度は抜群に高いがやや重たいため、好き嫌いが分かれる素材

desc.en: Causes weapon to enhance attack power. Effect: Increases attack power by 5.
desc.ja: 武器の攻撃力を強化する。効果：攻撃力が５上昇する

desc.en: Causes weapon to enhance attack power. Effect: Increases attack power by 10.
desc.ja: 武器の攻撃力を強化する。効果：攻撃力が１０上昇する

desc.en: Reduces the consumption of MP. Effect: Reduces MP consumption of skills by 10％.
desc.ja: 消費ＭＰを軽減する効果を付与する。効果：スキルの消費ＭＰを１０％軽減する
